description: One metric bucketed over time (hour or day). Use for 'plot pageviews per day this month' or 'visitors per hour today'. Returns an array of {time, value} points.

interval.description: Bucket size. Use 'hour' for short ranges, 'day' for longer.

range.description: Date range. Accepts natural strings ('today', 'yesterday', 'last 7 days', 'last 30 days', 'this week', 'last week', 'this month', 'last month') or an explicit 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD' range. UTC. If you have separate from/to dates, use the explicit form.

site_id.description: Site ID. Get it from list_sites if you don't know it.

name: get_timeseries
